crossRefs.note: Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”
Those who ate were four thousand men, in addition to women and children.
He asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven.”
Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet…

parallels.note: “When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him…

translations.web: Nor the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?
translations.bsb: Or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?
translations.kjv: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
translations.asv: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
